excerpt: The facility is capable of accelerating protons up to 800 MeV. It was the most powerful linear accelerator in the world when it was opened in June 1972. In 1995 LAMPF was renamed the Los Alamos Neutron Science Center (LANSCE). Located in New Mexico at Los Alamos National Laboratory in Technical Area 53, coordinates 35 52'09''N 106 15'43''W.
